per_theorem.name: test_double
tactics:
induction n with

per_theorem.name: test_sum_sq
tactics:
induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp only [sumSq]; grind

per_theorem.name: test_sq_mod_four
tactics: have h4 : n % 4 = 0 ∨ n % 4 = 1 ∨ n % 4 = 2 ∨ n % 4 = 3 := by omega
rcases h4 with h | h | h | h <;> rw [Nat.mul_mod, h] <;> decide
